messages:
maria: Heads up: planning to enable new scaling lanes flag (scaling_lanes_v2) for a small prod canary tomorrow 09:00 PT. Quick sanity check — audience, guardrails, and rollback plan? cc @devon @lee

devon: Sounds good. What's the exact audience %? Also want to confirm the max_concurrency guardrail and the queueing/burst policy.

maria: Plan is 5% prod traffic, 100% staging. Guardrails: soft cap max_concurrency=64 per-model, queueing enabled with max_queue=100, burst_tokens=500. Autoscale burst path only on compatible instance types.

lee: Can we get telemetry hooks ready? Metric set: serve_latency_p50/p95, queue_length, reject_rate, token_cost. Alert if p95 > 400ms or reject_rate > 0.5% for 5m.

priya: I'll add those to the dashboard. Where do you want canary routing to live? region=us-west-2 only?

maria: Yes, us-west-2 only to start. Fallback policy: route to baseline model variant if capacity degrades. Runbook link: https://redwood/ops/runbooks/scaling-lanes

devon: Small nit: can we set an automated soft rollback to max_concurrency=32 on spike? Otherwise oncall will have to intervene. Suggest an automated rollout job that monitors p95 & reject_rate and downgrades the flag if thresholds hit.

oncall-bot: Reminder: oncall rotation this week is @sam. Pager policy: escalate after 15m. Use `/pager ack` to silence during tests.

sam: I'll be on standby during the window. Also suggest enabling debug traces for ~10% of canary requests to capture KV cache hit/miss and trace latencies.

maria: Good call — debug traces enabled. Config snippet I'm about to PR:
```json
{"flag":"scaling_lanes_v2","audience":"prod:5%","regions":["us-west-2"],"max_concurrency":64,"soft_rollback_threshold":{"p95_ms":400,"reject_rate_pct":0.5},"burst_tokens":500,"debug_trace_pct":10}
```
I'll push to infra-flags and request review.

priya: Will review. Also adding a smoke-test checklist: warmup traffic, run 10k light requests, monitor queue_length, verify token cost delta < 2%.

devon: :thumbsup: Also gate rollout to nodes with proper quantization profile — last time a node had the wrong kernel and latencies spiked.

maria: Agreed. Gate by node label `quant-profile=avx512-q4` in the rollout. Including that in the PR.

sam: If anyone wants to run a manual preflight, I'm free 08:30–09:30 PT tomorrow.
